study_type_evidence.quote: To determine plasma IgG1-AM (6-52) and IgG4-AM (6-52) concentrations, 30 nmol/kg Fc-AMs were administered subcutaneously to rats (n = 2/group).

in_vivo_species.quote: All male 7-week-old Wistar rats were purchased from Charles River Laboratories Japan (Kanagawa, Japan)
Male 8-week-old spontaneously hypertensive rats (SHRs) were purchased from Charles River Laboratories

concentration_time_figure.caption_quote: Plasma disappearance of IgG1-AM (6-52) and IgG4-AM (6-52) over time. Concentrations of mature AM and total AM in plasma.
concentration_time_figure.note: Sampled to 14 days for the Fc fusions and to 120 min for native AM.

bioanalytical_method: Two ELISAs on the same plasma samples, one for mature AM (mAM) and one for total AM (tAM); PK parameters computed in WinNonlin
bioanalytical_quote: The PK parameters (Vz/F, CL/F, T1/2, and Ke) were calculated with WinNonlin at the BoZo Research Center Inc. (Tsukuba, Japan).
notes: All six PEPlife2 values verified against Table 1 and the Results text (PEPlife2's 3.23 d is the text's rounding of Table 1's 3.235 d). Two cautions for downstream use. (1) mAM and tAM are two ELISA READOUTS of the SAME dosed animals, not two experiments - IgG1 contributes both 2.11 d and 2.885 d, and treating them as independent records double-counts each construct. (2) The Fc-AM arms are n = 2 per group, and the whole study used 8 rats; these half-lives carry very little precision and no dispersion is reported. Native AM was dosed at 50 nmol/kg while the Fc fusions were dosed at 30 nmol/kg, so the comparison is not dose-matched. Sequences are PEPlife2's; the body does not print them.
